primary_non_adoption_reasons.reason: In the selection-unexposed four-fold by three-seed confirmation, zero of three seeds passed the preregistered tail-specific locality gate because tail-minus-clean worsened in every seed.

evidence.mechanism_observation: Clean mean value shifted downward more than tail mean value in all three seeds, consistent with the unanchored absolute-margin objective using a broad negative-value shift rather than tail-local lowering.

primary_non_adoption_reasons.reason: R1 removed the row-constant-shift shortcut and learned tail-below-pre, but it did not constrain clean trajectories; clean values moved down more than tail values and the preregistered tail-versus-clean locality guard failed.

The auxiliary R1 gradients share the encoder with sparse localization and caused regressions larger than the preregistered tolerances on both semantic token-value localization and sparse-span localization.

Component adoption requires improvement on its intended tail-local diagnostic without an unacceptable regression in protected localization or correctness metrics. Post-hoc weight, margin, epoch, or threshold scans are not allowed to override a failed frozen gate.

explicit_non_reasons: Tail was not rejected because it had zero measurable effect: both T2 and R1 changed value rankings, and R1 strongly improved tail-versus-pre diagnostics.
Tail was not rejected because correctness catastrophically failed: R1 correctness AUROC stayed within its preregistered tolerance.
Full tail was not redefined as token hallucination ground truth: it remains a separate post-error continuation-value hypothesis that intentionally includes supported and unreviewed post-onset tokens.
The full-tail hypothesis family is not permanently falsified by these pipeline-pilot results.

operational_consequences.future_reopening_condition: Publish a new protocol that explicitly controls a matched clean positional baseline and measures or isolates shared-encoder interference with sparse localization.
